resources.string: ChefMate keeps every part of home cooking in one place — the recipes you love, the meals you’re planning, and the groceries you need to buy. This quick tour walks through the essentials so you can hit the ground running.

Browse the web without leaving ChefMate using the built-in browser. When you land on a recipe you like, tap Download and ChefMate pulls in the ingredients, steps, and photo automatically — no copying and pasting. Every recipe you save syncs to your account so it’s ready on all your devices.

Open any saved recipe and tap Cook Mode to enter a distraction-free, step-by-step view built for the kitchen. Text stays large and easy to read from a distance, and your screen won’t dim mid-recipe, so you can keep both hands on the food and glance over whenever you’re ready for the next step.

Add a recipe’s ingredients to your grocery list with a single tap, and ChefMate combines duplicates so you’re not buying the same thing twice. Items are grouped to make shopping quick, and you can tick them off as you go so nothing gets left behind at the store.

Drop recipes into breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snacks for any day of the week to map out what you’ll cook. Seeing the whole week at a glance takes the guesswork out of “what’s for dinner,” and you can send a plan’s ingredients straight to your grocery list when it’s time to shop.

That’s the whole tour. Save your favorite recipes, plan out your week, and build grocery lists that keep you organized — all from one app. Jump in whenever you’re ready; you can revisit these features any time from the app.
